tasks.analysis: Paleontology is the scientific study that deals with the history of life through the analysis of fossil records. This field involves examining fossils—remains of organisms preserved in rock—to understand how ancient life-forms evolved and adapted to their surroundings. Paleontologists also use fossils to learn about ancient environmental conditions.
